facebook.caption:
6,143 reviews on a bistro in Phu Quoc. That number doesn't lie.

Chuồn Chuồn Bistro & Bar on Trần Hưng Đạo keeps pulling people back. Solid 4.3 stars across thousands of visits. Budget around $15-30 per person and you're set for a full meal with drinks.

Not every well-reviewed spot earns it. This one has. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
